# PM008: ticket-aged

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

|---|---|

| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A ticket has stayed in its category longer than `[pm.max_age_days]` allows.

Fires once per aged ticket, naming the category and the age in days.
Limits: `in_progress` (default 3) and `ready` (default 30); 0 is off.

## Remedy

Finish or land the ticket, requeue or re-plan it, drop it with a reason, or
raise `[pm.max_age_days]` in `frob.toml`.

## Examples

### PM008 ticket aging per category / In progress past the limit fires with the age #1 (line 10) (fire)

```text
later_days 5
task a state=in_progress
```

### PM008 ticket aging per category / In progress within the limit is silent #2 (line 17) (clean)

```text
later_days 2
task a state=in_progress
```

### PM008 ticket aging per category / A zero in-progress limit is off #3 (line 24) (clean)

```text
later_days 40
max_age_in_progress 0
task a state=in_progress
```

### PM008 ticket aging per category / A ready ticket past its limit fires #4 (line 32) (fire)

```text
later_days 31
task a points=1
```

### PM008 ticket aging per category / A ready ticket within its limit is silent #5 (line 39) (clean)

```text
later_days 10
task a points=1
```

### PM008 ticket aging per category / Epics do not age #6 (line 46) (clean)

```text

epic e
```
